SH-31.title: UTF-8 safe truncation
SH-31.acceptance_criteria: msg.truncate(3900) does not appear in src/app.rs; floor_char_boundary appears in the truncation block; New test: create stories with multi-byte UTF-8 titles (CJK/emoji) that push systemMessage past 3900 bytes — assert exit 0, valid JSON, systemMessage present; cargo test passes
SH-31.design_section: Replace `msg.truncate(3900)` with `msg.truncate(msg.floor_char_boundary(3900))` at `src/app.rs:2186`. One-line fix using floor_char_boundary (stable since Rust 1.76, project requires 1.89). Note: after truncation, appending '...(truncated)' (17 bytes) plus JSON envelope could push total over 4000 chars — the 3900 limit works but the margin is tight.

SH-32.title: Proper TOML parsing for plugin config
SH-32.acceptance_criteria: contains("= false") and contains("= \"false\"") do not appear in src/app.rs; toml::from_str or toml::de appears in plugin config section; Existing test session_start_plugin_config_extra_whitespace_bug_documented updated to assert {} (fixed behavior); New tests: (a) no-space enabled=false, (b) comments + extra keys, (c) [plugin] nested table; Existing tests for enabled=true, enabled=false, enabled="false", malformed all pass; cargo test passes
SH-32.design_section:
Replace `contains("= false")` string matching at `src/app.rs:2127-2131` with `toml` crate parsing. CRITICAL: Must handle BOTH config formats — with section: `[plugin]
enabled = false
` (written by `story plugin install`) AND bare key: `enabled = "false"
` (used in tests at session_start.rs:60 and session_start_hook.rs:127). Recommended struct: top-level `enabled` + optional `plugin.enabled`, check both. Must preserve fail-open behavior: malformed/missing config treated as enabled.

SH-33.acceptance_criteria: In render_response(), Response::RawJson arm appears before the if quiet check; New test: story --quiet session-start on a valid project returns non-empty valid JSON with systemMessage key; cargo test passes
SH-33.design_section: In `render_response()` at `src/output.rs:117-119`, move the RawJson match arm before the `if quiet` early return. RawJson is structured data output (like session-start JSON) that should always be emitted regardless of quiet mode.

SH-36.title: Sync VERSION and Cargo.toml versions
SH-36.acceptance_criteria: Cargo.toml contains version = "0.12.0"; .semver/hooks/post-bump/sync-cargo-toml.sh exists, is executable, references Cargo.toml; cargo build succeeds; New test: VERSION and Cargo.toml versions match (after stripping v prefix)
SH-36.design_section: Two changes: (1) Update Cargo.toml version from "0.6.0" to "0.12.0" (matching VERSION file, no v prefix). (2) Create post-bump hook at `.semver/hooks/post-bump/sync-cargo-toml.sh` that strips the v prefix from $NEW_VERSION and updates Cargo.toml version field, then `git add Cargo.toml && git commit --amend --no-edit`. Semver plugin uses post-bump hooks (not config keys) for tracking additional files.
